utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the sixth, and Teams has actually let us all in. Can you hear me over that fan?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, just. Whose new car is that in the car park? It's taking up about a bay and a half.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one worth less than the tyres on it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Never mind the car, the broken coffee machine in the canteen has ruined my morning. Brown water, no actual coffee.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: So it's operating to its usual specification, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There is birthday cake in the office, if that helps. Not a balanced breakfast, but there you go.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Depends how level you cut the slice.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a catering meeting. Finished bits first, then what's actually on the list.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I tested the air dryer yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's complete, then? Nothing carrying over from that?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Complete, yeah. Just reporting it back, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the waste heat boiler last night. That one's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Two things off rather than two things back on.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Also, we were going to replace the belt on the fire panel, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it. Not part of today's work.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, cancelled out of this list. I wondered why it was still showing.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: saw the pressure on the guard switch on two dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit there. Came back without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Not asking for a job off the back of that, just saying what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the 11kV board. Same blocker as before.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So there's no confirmed delivery to put into the programme.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. Still blocked, not a fresh action for anyone this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, I'll do the pre-use checks on the forklifts on Friday. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fi. Friday for the forklifts, and keeping that marked urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take those.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya, can you inspect the water booster for leaks by Thursday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll inspect the water booster for leaks by Thursday. Understood, that comes first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It's the leak inspection on that one, specifically.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Got you. Inspection for leaks, not signing up to a whole rebuild.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll swap the filter on the booster pump on Friday. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Aisha. Booster pump filter on Friday, no rush. Separate from the water booster inspection.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, were those two being lumped together? I was talking over the end of that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, separate jobs. Filter swap's the no-rush one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Aisha, can you take vibration readings on the turbine one today at 2pm? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take vibration readings on the turbine one today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Heard that one properly. My audio's stopped doing the underwater thing.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Lucky you. Mine's mostly fan noise and the occasional word.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Well, the important words were fairly important and 2pm. Thanks, Aisha.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll write up the near miss at the wrapper on Friday as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fiona. That's the write-up. What priority have we got against it?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Normal priority. I'll have the write-up done on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the write-up rather than a new investigation we're adding, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, just the write-up of the near miss at the wrapper.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team by Wednesday? Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team by Wednesday. Low priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: So that doesn't jump ahead of your leak inspection.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, I've got the distinction. Production hold first, toolbox talk low priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll investigate the pressure drop on the water booster myself. That's a whenever you get a chance one, rather than another urgent job.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And that's separate from looking for leaks? Just so we're not treating them as one action.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, separate. I'll take the pressure-drop investigation; no fixed deadline on that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got Sarah Okafor against the pressure drop, then, with whenever you get a chance as the priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you do a site visit at Harbour Road with the contractor next week?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the site visit at Harbour Road with the contractor next week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just next week against that, not a particular day?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, next week is what we've got agreed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine by me. I've got that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Anyone trying to speak while muted? There's usually one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: For once, not me. Nothing else from controls; the air dryer was just the completed update.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Nothing else here either. The 11kV board is still a blocker, not something we've picked up today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. No extra actions out of the observations or the blocked bit.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Important question, then. What sort of birthday cake?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Chocolate. And before anyone asks, I haven't measured the slices.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No quality control in that office. Shocking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we're done. Cheers, everyone.
